title: TICONN 6 Pack Extra Large Moving Bags Heavy Duty with Zippers & Carrying Handles, Durable Storage Bags Moving Boxes for Closet Organizers and Storage (6 Pack, Blue)
features: Extra large: 68 x 38 x 35.5 cm and up to 90 litre volume. An option for moving boxes and organizers, waterproof, perfect for space saving, moving and camping.
Durable: On the outside of the luggage/bag carry handles are very robust than sewn handles and make the bag suitable for heavy items.
Open top: The top can be opened completely and it is much easier to organize, fill and remove clothes, books or anything you want to put into it.
Easy Storage: The bag is made of folding materials. When not in use, you can simply store it on shelves where it doesn't take up much space.
Label Bag: The bag with the tag is placed in the upper right corner, allowing you to mark your luggage for easier identification.
